title: Equal-weight historical growth
question: How did an illustrative equal-weight portfolio of complete-coverage symbols evolve?
purpose: A daily rebalanced equal-weight illustration over the shared complete-coverage window.
accessibility_summary: Line shows the illustrative index; it excludes dividends, transaction costs, taxes, and survivorship corrections.

title: Risk and return dispersion
question: How did historical annualized price returns vary with volatility across symbols?
purpose: Displays the 467-symbol complete-coverage cohort; no risk-adjusted ranking is implied.
accessibility_summary: Each point is one complete-coverage symbol; axes are annualized using 252 trading days.

title: Historical drawdown
question: What was the decline from prior peaks in the illustrative price-return index?
purpose: Tracks peak-to-trough drawdown in the equal-weight illustration.
accessibility_summary: Drawdown remains at or below zero and excludes dividends and costs.

title: Selected indexed prices
question: How did indexed prices evolve for systematically sampled symbols?
purpose: Shows twelve symbols sampled at regular positions in alphabetical order, not selected by performance.
accessibility_summary: Each line starts at 100; symbols are sampled systematically from the full alphabetized cohort.

title: Selected-symbol return correlation
question: How strongly did daily returns co-move for the representative symbol sample?
purpose: Displays pairwise daily return correlation for the same systematic twelve-symbol sample.
accessibility_summary: Heatmap uses a fixed -1 to 1 scale and a diverging color map.
